text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—White Day is almost here.
I'd like to give Eishin Flash something in return, but...”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've been browsing online shops for the past few days,
but nothing really feels right. As I thought, going to an actual store and picking it out myself would be—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what have you been groaning about for a while now?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I've been here the whole time.
I called out to you several times,
but you didn't respond..."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: So, what happened to you?
choice_data_list: I-I'm fine! It's nothing at all!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Nein, it certainly didn't look that way.
Frankly speaking, their behavior was suspicious as well.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait... heh!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Naturally, I can't consult the very person
I'm giving a White Day gift to."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling a little guilty,
I hurriedly made my escape from the scene.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Flash-san's Trainer has been
spotted up ahead.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hello! Out shopping?
The weather's so nice today, it feels great out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I explained the situation and decided to ask for advice on a return gift for Eishin Flash.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about we check out
a nearby general store?
I'm sure they have lots of cute things!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I hear it's a popular shop among students.
City-san mentioned before that they carry cosmetics in addition to general goods.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I hope you find a wonderful present!
Oh, adding a message card might
make them extra happy too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After thanking the two of them,
I arrived at the popular shop rumored about, only to find
Tosen Jordan standing there—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
A return gift for Valentine's?
You're buying it here? Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
“Stuff like this comes down to taste, though, so isn't it tough?
To be real, getting something that isn't your style is kinda awkward.”

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, Flash-san would totally say something like, "It's the thought that counts,"
but I mean, if it's thanks for sweets, wouldn't sweets be just fine?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I looked around at the knick-knacks, but Tosen Jordan's words made me reconsider. And then—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see!
A return Valentine's gift, is it!
Giving thanks in return for everyday gratitude! How wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
By the way, I handed them out to my classmates,
but not because I expect anything in return!
I'm an honor student, after all!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A single 'thank you' is more than enough!
As expected of me! An honor student through and through!!
...Though if you're offering, I'll gladly take it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I can't decide. Sakura Bakushin O has
a point. But that alone isn't enough..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After agonizing over it, the conclusion reached was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to write not just a thank-you for Valentine's,
but also my daily gratitude and how inspired I am
by seeing your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After rewriting it over and over again,
night had completely fallen.
However, I managed to finish writing it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, just a letter alone
might feel a bit lackluster.
Perhaps I should—
choice_data_list: Maybe add some flowers or something...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The flower shop closed two hours ago.
So, let's leave that for next time.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Fufu. That's the second time today you've been surprised by me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...You said quite a bit of that out loud, you know.
You were really fretting over what to give me in return, weren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "Is that... a letter? For me?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I was aware of the White Day tradition,
but I never imagined I would actually receive anything.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Looking at your desk, you rewrote this so many times for me, didn't you?
Taking your time, over and over..."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Still, if you lightly sketch an outline first, you wouldn't need to use so many sheets—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
............
No, well... what I wanted to say
wasn't really that.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
“...... Thank you very much.
I will treasure this and read it carefully.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It wasn't the most graceful way to hand it over—but Eishin Flash held the letter close, treasuring it dearly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can't make beautiful pastries
like Eishin Flash does,
but maybe I can manage cupcakes...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking that, I immediately looked up a recipe
and decided to go buy the ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...As a result of looking around here and there.
choice_data_list: I wonder which one would be best for the cake...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even when you just say 'whipped cream,'
there are so many varieties.
Should I just pick an expensive one?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
What are you making?
If you're looking for something rich and flavorful,
I believe the one on the right shelf would serve you well.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Good grief...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If you were making a cake,
you should have just told me.
Are you holding back on me?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Or are there circumstances you can't talk about?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A Valentine's return gift for me...?
Ah... I see. That's right,
Japan does have the custom of White Day, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: However, it's already evening. If we start making it now...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: True, this isn't something I'm used to doing. There's no telling when it'll be finished. It doesn't look like it'll make it in time for White Day.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Please do not be so downcast.
Just the thought alone is more than enough."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"However... that's true. Why don't we
make it together sometime when you're free?
I'll teach you."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: You get to experience the joy of teaching, the joy of cooking, and the joy of eating what you made together.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Even if it isn't White Day, I'm sure the joy we feel is just the same. ...Right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash giggled softly
even while offering her comforting words.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, we enjoyed White Day together
while eating the cake the two of us had made.
